name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.common.utils.CommonFileProvider
description: NetEase Yunxin's shared IM library turns a local chat file into a link that app screens can open or share. ChatKit and QChat use it for images, videos, and other message attachments.
disableEffect: Sending, opening, or sharing local chat attachments may fail because the app cannot create the file links it expects.
